info.title: API.SH: StepStone
info.description: The StepStone API from API.SH: public StepStone data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
An employer on stepstone.de: id, name, links, logo, hero image, address, employee count, industries, the profile's about sections (text and HTML), benefits, videos, number of open jobs, popular job locations and skills, and its latest jobs (title, link, location, remote, salary when shown, snippet, posted and expiry dates, labels).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stepstone-company

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Company slug with id (adesso-se-7420), the numeric company id, or a stepstone.de/cmp/de/... link (company_url in job results).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every open job of an employer on stepstone.de, 25 a page, with the same fields as search results, the total, page count and facets (filters with counts) to narrow the list. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stepstone-company-jobs

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Company slug with id, numeric id or stepstone.de/cmp/de/... link.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Only jobs in this city, e.g. berlin.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the jobs.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet filter value from facets[].values[].filter, e.g. fsk=673826 (repeatable).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One StepStone.de or Totaljobs job ad (give a totaljobs.com job URL for Totaljobs): the ad's sections (about us, tasks, profile, benefits…) as HTML and text plus the full description, company (id, page, logo, address, jobs count), location and address, contract and work type, employment type, industry, posted and valid-through dates, salary range (StepStone's estimate when the ad has none) and whether it takes direct applications. Removed jobs answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stepstone-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id (the number at the end of the job URL, before `-inline.html`) or the job URL. Totaljobs jobs need their totaljobs.com URL (`url` in search results with `country=uk`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs on StepStone.de for a keyword and/or location, with the site's filters: radius, sort, posting age, home office, full/part time, minimum salary, and every facet the results page offers (contract type, experience, discipline, category, sector, city, region, skills, application method, language). `country=uk` searches Totaljobs (StepStone's UK board) with the same fields; its facets (salary, work policy, discipline, contract type, skills, category, sector, city, region, application method) work the same way. `total` is StepStone's count; 25 jobs per page. Facets come back in `facets`; pass a value's `filter` (e.g. `ct=222`) back as `filter` (repeatable). Each job: `id`, `global_id`, `title`, `url`, `company`, `company_id`, `company_url`, `logo`, `location`, `remote`, `salary` (StepStone's range, `predicted` when it is the site's estimate), `snippet`, `benefits`, `posted_at`, `expires_at`, `top_job`, `sponsored`, `labels`, `skills` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stepstone-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `python`, `projektmanager`. Required unless `location` is given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `de` (default): StepStone.de. `uk`: Totaljobs (totaljobs.com).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or region, e.g. `berlin`.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius around the location, in km (up to 100; larger values use 100). With `country=uk`: miles, 0, 5, 10, 20 or 30 (other values use the next larger one, at most 30).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: age
parameters.description: Posted within this many days (`country=de` only).

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: Home office: `partly` (hybrid) or `only` (remote); `onsite` only with `country=uk`.

parameters.name: work_type
parameters.description: Full or part time (`country=de` only).

parameters.name: salary_min
parameters.description: Minimum yearly salary in EUR, or GBP with `country=uk` (the site's bands: 10000 to 100000).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: More filters as `key=value` from `facets[].values[].filter`. Repeatable.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
